Men's Performance Short Sleeve Polo

Built for long walks and changing conditions. Soft piqué knit pulls moisture away and stays breathable from the first tee to the last green, with the Hesedea icon on the chest and the wordmark on the sleeve.

  • 6 oz. 100% polyester piqué with a soft, cotton-like feel
  • Moisture-wicking and antimicrobial
  • Colorfast fabric that holds its color wash after wash
  • Three-button placket, self-fabric collar with collar stays
  • Side vents for a full swing
  • Icon logo on chest, wordmark on sleeve

Part of Consider, the Hesedea golf line rooted in Psalm 107:43: "let them Consider the Hesed of the Lord."

Made to order. Each piece is made when you order it and typically ships in about a week. We'll email tracking as soon as it's on the way.

Net proceeds from every Hesedea purchase support Mully Children’s Family, caring for orphaned and vulnerable children in Kenya.
